chunks: (Another will say:)'Is it true, we are not going to die
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say when they realized death was final?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff (37), this rhetorical question marks the moment of realization for the disbelievers who, having rejected the promise of resurrection in life, now face the finality of death and the onset of the Hereafter. Shia exegetes often link this to the concept of *Barzakh* (the barrier between death and resurrection), highlighting how the denial of the soul's continuity leads to their ultimate despair. The verse underscores the psychological shift from arrogant denial to helpless acceptance of divine decree.
